'''Zyk-yadoon''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]], who made a [[holoplacard]] depicting [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]] during the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|Battle of Ossus]]. The holoplacard was part of the collection of artifacts on show in [[Remembrance Hall]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] museum in [[Forard]], on [[Almas]].
